frozen_at: 2026-10-17, before any code or measurement of references
purpose: Classify each picture change found by the qualified av-event-meter as a SCENE change (most of the frame replaced) or a LOCAL change (a caption, text box, overlay or small region replaced over a persistent picture). Motivated by the pilot-001 review: the references' 28-36 changes/min were mostly caption changes.

method.change_times: av-event-meter v2 video events (unchanged, already qualified)
method.proxy: gray 96x54, area scaling, every decoded frame
method.compare: mean of frames in [t-0.40, t-0.15] s versus mean of frames in [t+0.15, t+0.40] s, so fades of up to 0.3 s and small motion are averaged
method.otherwise: LOCAL; its changed-cell bounding box (rows/columns) is reported as the overlay region
method.centre_kept: for a SCENE change, the 4x4 centre cells (columns 4-7, rows 1-4) are 'kept' if at most 25% of them changed; reported as persistent-figure evidence, not used for SCENE/LOCAL

controls.q5_persistent_figure_with_changing_backg: every change SCENE (background replacement counts as a scene change; figure persistence is reported separately)

qualification.pass: each control: at least 90% of detected changes classified as expected and at least 80% of planted changes detected
qualification.references: after controls pass, classify the 9 cohort openings and render one before/after thumbnail pair per change for visual spot check of at least 20 changes; the classification is accepted for production targets only if at least 90% of the spot-checked changes agree with the visual judgement

limits: Gray-level only; a colour-only change of equal luma is missed. Slow camera motion that crosses the threshold without a cut is already excluded by the meter. Not a quality verdict.
